claim_boundary.supports: Kernel-checked for arbitrary types PD, S, with Real0 PD S given the two-constructor shape of OntologyBasic.Real0: both injections are injective, their ranges are disjoint and exhaustive, Real0 is equivalent to PD + S, every pair of maps out of the channels has exactly one extension (universal property), and the number of maps out of the coproduct is the product of the numbers of maps out of the channels (|C|^(|PD|+|S|)). A map out of the coproduct that is the identity on one channel (a retraction onto it) exists iff that channel is nonempty or the other channel is empty: a retraction onto the difference channel is impossible only when that channel is empty and the structure channel is not (and symmetrically); whenever both channels are inhabited retractions in both directions exist (retractions_both_ways_of_nonempty), each one of |A|^|B| choices that the coproduct does not select. So bare function-existence is trivial for inhabited channels and does NOT formalise "no reduction of either channel to the other". Real0 is nonempty iff a channel is, empty for two empty channels, and all four combinations of the two nonemptiness posits are realised, so neither posit follows from the construction or from the other. Native exhaustive tables: 38 map counts (|A|,|B| <= 2 with |C| <= 3, plus (3,2,2) and (2,3,2)), 16 retraction tables for |A|,|B| <= 3, and the four-row posit table; the injection, disjointness and covering columns are set facts built from the tags, so the kernel theorems are the evidence for them.
claim_boundary.does_not_support: Anything about the actual OntologyBasic.Real0 beyond its constructor shape (the file is not imported; its payloads are universe-polymorphic record types). The real Real0 has the record TYPES PrimitiveDifference and Structure as channels; both are inhabited, so by retracts_to_pd_iff and retracts_to_s_iff retractions in both directions exist for it: the emptiness cases of this file are not instances of the real node, and nothing here says either channel is irreducible to the other. That either channel exists, is real or has an origin (admitted posits, ENC-1138 lineage withdrawn); the passage from the literal inscription (PG-INERT-DIAMOND, route marked GAP_NO_DERIVATION); the clauses "carrier-Structure precedes a primitive difference", "residual-Structure Q^1 = C^1/im d0 is what the difference produces" and "the ladder is a definability order"; any physical or interpretive reading.
claim_boundary.narrowest_claim: The typed coproduct of two payload types (same two-constructor shape as OntologyBasic.Real0) is a categorical coproduct that supplies no map between the channels and no element of either channel: a map out of it that is the identity on one channel exists exactly when that channel is nonempty or the other is empty (so bare existence of such a map is not a reduction theorem for inhabited channels), and the two nonemptiness conditions are independent of the construction and of each other.
claim_boundary.next_test: Formalise the clause "carrier-Structure precedes a primitive difference": define precedence as the statement that a PrimitiveDifference record can be built with no Structure value in scope (Source := PUnit) and a Structure record with no PrimitiveDifference, then decide whether Source must equal Structure.Carrier for the node text to be meant, by a finite model or a counterexample.

dag_suggestion.statement: Admitted root of the programme: Real_0 = PrimitiveDifference ⊔ Structure, a typed coproduct of two independently posited channels. As a type construction (arbitrary payload types, same two-constructor shape as OntologyBasic.Real0) the coproduct is a categorical coproduct that singles out no map between the channels and supplies no element of either; the existence of a map out of it that is the identity on one channel holds exactly when that channel is nonempty or the other is empty, so for inhabited channels (as the real record types are) bare function-existence is not a no-reduction theorem. [The clauses 'carrier-Structure precedes a primitive difference', 'residual-Structure (Q^1 = C^1/im d0) is what the difference produces' and 'the ladder is a definability order and mints no authority' are not addressed.]
dag_suggestion.bottleneck: Admitted, not derived. earlier_pass.notes: Lean file compiles (exit 0); the 16 anchors state what supports says for arbitrary Type-0 PD, S (injectivity, disjointness, exhaustiveness, universal, card, retraction iff, nonempty iff, posits_independent). Axioms: universal uses Quot.sound; card/retraction anchors use propext+Classical.choice+Quot.sound; so no 'axiom-free' wording may be added. MAIN PROBLEM, bridge from the toy to the real node: the real OntologyBasic.Real0 has constructors taking the RECORD values PrimitiveDifference / Structure, so its two channels are the record types, which are both inhabited (Source:=PUnit, Target:=PUnit; Carrier:=PUnit with True props). By retracts_to_pd_iff / retracts_to_s_iff a retraction in BOTH directions therefore exists for the real Real0. The theorem 'no reduction' only bites for an EMPTY channel, a case the real node never has; for any nonempty pair retractions exist (|A|^|B| of them, table rows). So the phrases 'so with an empty difference channel and a nonempty structure channel there is no reduction' and 'a retraction ... exists exactly when ...' do not support the DAG sentence 'the coproduct asserts no reduction of either channel to the other'; they show only that nothing in the coproduct construction forces or forbids a reduction map, and that a bare function-existence notion of reduction is the wrong one (trivial whenever the target is nonempty). The claim boundary must say so, otherwise a reader takes retracts_to_pd_iff as a non-reduction theorem about Real_0. Second: the 'Native exhaustive tables' do not exhaust what is described: 'maps' has |A|,|B|<=2, |C|<=3 plus only two rows with a 3 (36+2=38); the spec 'construction' string says 'channels of size up to 3 and codomains of size up to 3', false for the maps table. Checker: independent only in that it uses closed forms, and several leaves are tautologies or asserted constants: unique_copairs is set to c^a*c^b (identical to total_maps by the same formula, so the universal property is not tested by the checker at all, only by the producer's enumeration compared with the closed form); inl_injective/inr_injective are len(set of tagged tuples)==a (true by construction), disjoint/covering are set facts about tags the checker itself builds; real0_nonempty_iff_a_channel_is is the constant True in the checker and a tautology (len>0)==(a>0 or b>0) in the producer and the Rust; product_matches is total==left*right with all values from the same formula. Acceptable for a neutrality node only if the claim credits the kernel theorems (not the tables) for injective/disjoint/exhaustive; the 'independent_predicates' text 'Injection facts from explicit tagged sets' overstates the checker. Mutants: ranges_overlap, coproduct_size_is_max, structure_posit_entails_difference, coproduct_nonempty_without_posits and some_pair_has_no_copair are single flipped fields; reduction_always_exists, reduction_is_canonical, swapped_direction and maps_out_count_is_a_sum are genuine misreadings of a stated bridge. Missing near misses: (a) both channels empty (a=b=0): a retraction EXISTS (empty map, 0^0=1) although Real0 is empty; (b) retractions counted as a^b vs b^a swapped at a=2,b=3 (8 vs 9) - swapped_direction only swaps booleans at (0,1); (c) 'retraction exists whenever the other channel is nonempty' (converse error); (d) uniqueness of copairs at c=0 (0^0); (e) a nonempty/nonempty row claiming exists_to_pd False, i.e. 'irreducible', exactly the DAG's wrong reading. next_test: it is this node's own open clause (precedence), but it is the first item of does_not_support re-stated as a task, and 'whether delta can be defined without the structure carrier' needs a fixed meaning of 'defined without'. In fact the existing record types already show delta needs no Structure (PrimitiveDifference has no Structure field; Source is an arbitrary Sort), a one-line Lean example that could be the next theorem. Composition tree: the profile lists 'copair(f, g) o inject_difference = f' in composition_tree but the operad delta moves exactly that composition to failed_compositions (colour mismatch); inconsistent.
